note: Rarely sold in shops: mostly backyards, pick-your-own and farmers markets. No market reports name mulberries. Old months (Oct-Nov peak) were too early.

pick: Heavy with lots of liquid sloshing when shaken; eyes (the three dots) dry, not mouldy.
storage: Whole on the bench a few weeks; opened, fridge 4-5 days.

sources.name: IndexBox, Australia coconut market
sources.says: Domestic coconut production is negligible, under 1 per cent of consumption (via search summary).

sources.name: Vietnamese wax coconuts enter Australian market (FreshPlaza)
sources.says: Fresh coconuts reach Australia as imports (via search summary).

note: Imported all year; no seasonality. App should not show peak months.

pick: Vivid skin with fresh-looking green wing tips, slight give. Skip dry, shrivelled skin.
storage: Fridge, up to a week.

sources.name: Northern Territory Government: Pitaya (dragon fruit)
sources.says: NT fruits September to March; Darwin season October to April (via search summary).

sources.name: ABC Rural via ITFnet: NT dragon fruit season
sources.says: NT harvest ramps up after Australia Day, runs to April (via search summary).

note: Qld season roughly Dec-May. No Melbourne Market report names dragon fruit; peak inferred as mid-summer. Old Nov-Feb peak narrowed.

pick: Firm, yellow with slight brown on the ridge edges (that is ripe). Skip green or soft.
storage: Bench to ripen, then fridge about a week.

sources.name: Rare Fruit Council of Australia archive, carambola
sources.says: North Qld peaks Dec-Feb and Jun-Aug; southern Qld/northern NSW Feb-Mar (via search summary).

sources.name: Daleys Fruit, carambola
sources.says: Harvest March to September (via search summary).

note: Sources contradict; not seen in any Melbourne Market report. Old months kept.
